Topic 3.3: Baptism of Jesus Jesus Christ

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Baptism of Jesus Jesus Christ. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. explain what Baptism of Jesus Jesus Christ means in simple pupil language
2. give 3 correct examples of Baptism of Jesus Jesus Christ from Kenya
3. practise Baptism of Jesus Jesus Christ in clear steps
4. apply Baptism of Jesus Jesus Christ in one real-life situation this week

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE STUDYING: BAPTISM OF JESUS JESUS CHRIST
Subject: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION · Grade: Grade 1
This is a learner study lesson (not a teacher guide). Read every part, follow the models, then practise.

BIG PICTURE
Baptism of Jesus Jesus Christ helps you succeed in CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION. You will understand it, practise it, and use it at home, at your place of worship, and at school.

KEY FACTS: BAPTISM OF JESUS JESUS CHRIST
Study Baptism of Jesus Jesus Christ like a learner textbook page: meaning → examples → practice → check.
Replace teacher words with your own words.
If a step is unclear, rewrite it shorter and try again.

PART 1: Explain what Baptism of Jesus Jesus Christ means in simple pupil language

What this means
In this part you learn to explain what Baptism of Jesus Jesus Christ means in simple pupil language. You will use ideas from at home, at your place of worship, and at school.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: explain what Baptism of Jesus Jesus Christ means in simple pupil language.
2. Reflect, retell, then practise a good habit using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Value in action: Show how “Baptism of Jesus Jesus Christ” looks when you treat a classmate kindly.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can explain what Baptism of Jesus Jesus Christ means in simple pupil language. Write or say your answer clearly.

PART 4: Apply Baptism of Jesus Jesus Christ in one real-life situation this week

What this means

How to learn it

Model

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can apply Baptism of Jesus Jesus Christ in one real-life situation this week. Write or say your answer clearly.

PUT IT TOGETHER
Close your notes and say aloud: what Baptism of Jesus Jesus Christ is, one example, and one way you will practise this week.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Example 1: Show how “Baptism of Jesus Jesus Christ” looks when you treat a classmate kindly. (skill: explain what Baptism of Jesus Jesus Christ means in simple pupil language)

Example 2: Retell a short faith/values story connected to Baptism of Jesus Jesus Christ in your own words. (skill: give 3 correct examples of Baptism of Jesus Jesus Christ from Kenya)

Example 3: Choose one good action to practise today because of this lesson. (skill: practise Baptism of Jesus Jesus Christ in clear steps)

Example 4: Show how “Baptism of Jesus Jesus Christ” looks when you treat a classmate kindly. (skill: apply Baptism of Jesus Jesus Christ in one real-life situation this week)

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Write 5 sentences (or show 5 clear steps) that teach Baptism of Jesus Jesus Christ to a classmate.
2. Practise this skill: explain what Baptism of Jesus Jesus Christ means in simple pupil language.
3. Practise this skill: give 3 correct examples of Baptism of Jesus Jesus Christ from Kenya.
4. Practise this skill: practise Baptism of Jesus Jesus Christ in clear steps.
5. Make one local Kenya example of Baptism of Jesus Jesus Christ from your county, market, farm, or school.
6. Mark your own work: What did you get right? What will you redo?

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. In your exercise book, make a one-page revision sheet for Baptism of Jesus Jesus Christ: meaning, 3 examples, 5 practice items.
2. Teach a parent/guardian or younger sibling one part of this lesson (2 minutes).
3. Answer in writing: Why should a Grade 1 learner study Baptism of Jesus Jesus Christ?
4. Prepare for the quiz: cover the Remember box and recite it.

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. Know what Baptism of Jesus Jesus Christ means in your own words.
2. Use local Kenyan examples, not only definitions.
3. Practise in small steps, then check your work.
4. Be able to: explain what Baptism of Jesus Jesus Christ means in simple pupil language.
5. Be able to: give 3 correct examples of Baptism of Jesus Jesus Christ from Kenya.

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.
